steps.note: Create an event with a Technical Stage accessible to the vendor.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Populate the buyer-specified technical questions and values.
Invite the QA vendor whose response screen is being tested.
Publish the event so the vendor can access the Technical Stage.
Confirm the event is available on its project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event directly on the vendor's Technical Stage questionnaire.
Open the vendor's Quick Fill control.
Choose the option intended to copy the buyer's requested values into the vendor responses.
Confirm the Quick Fill operation did not produce an application error.
Confirm the resulting vendor questionnaire screen has no crash, server error, or invalid displayed values.
